text: Very pretty girl. She had the most beautiful teeth I ever saw. Oh, really gorgeous, both of them. In fact, she had three, but one was back so far, you couldn't see it, so I'm not counting that. Well, anyway, I said to myself, having saved this girl's life, I will propose to her and get married. They do that in the books, and I was out of work anyway, so I picked out a nice evening for the terrible deed, and when I rang the bell, she met me at the door. I had a little bouquet of flowers in my hand,
